# The scripts of the ticket pipeline alone: the plan of a range, the readiness check, the extract, the reservation of the budget, the validation of the labels
# (a label that is not allowed, a missing ticket, label drift) and the empty day.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipefakes
pipeinit
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe
env PIPE_VERSION=2
env PIPE_BACKFILL=bf-1
env PIPE_BUDGET_CENTS=3
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

# The plan refuses a date that does not exist, a range that runs backwards and a range above the limit.
! exec sh pl/scripts/plan.sh 2026-02-30 2026-03-01
stderr 'not a real date'
! exec sh pl/scripts/plan.sh 2026-03-05 2026-03-01
stderr 'is before the first day'
env PIPE_MAX_DAYS=3
! exec sh pl/scripts/plan.sh 2026-03-01 2026-03-09
stderr 'limit is 3'
env PIPE_MAX_DAYS=5000
exec sh pl/scripts/plan.sh 2026-03-01 2026-03-03
cmp stdout days.txt

# The readiness check: a closed day gives 0, an open day gives 2.
exec sh pl/scripts/ready.sh 2026-03-01
! exec sh pl/scripts/ready.sh 2026-03-02
stdout 'has not closed 2026-03-02'

# The extract reads two pages for 5 tickets and holds each ticket once.
exec sh pl/scripts/extract.sh 2026-03-03
stdout '^5 tickets, sha '
grep -count=2 'day=2026-03-03' curl.log
exec sh pl/scripts/extract.sh 2026-03-01
stdout '^3 tickets, sha '

# The reservation is made once for each day, and a day that does not fit is refused.
exec sh pl/scripts/budget.sh 2026-03-01
stdout 'reserved 1 cents for 3 tickets'
exec sh pl/scripts/budget.sh 2026-03-01
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spend'
stdout '^1$'
exec sh pl/scripts/budget.sh 2026-03-03
stdout 'reserved 2 cents'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spend'
stdout '^2$'
exec sh pl/scripts/extract.sh 2026-03-04
! exec sh pl/scripts/budget.sh 2026-03-04
stdout 'budget spent: 3 of 3 cents reserved, and 2026-03-04 needs 1'
! exec sh pl/scripts/budget-left.sh
stdout 'budget spent'

# The validation: a label that is not allowed, a ticket with no label, and a good file.
exec sh -c 'jq -c "{id, label: \"bug\"}" pipe/stage/2026-03-01/records.jsonl > pipe/stage/2026-03-01/labels.jsonl'
exec sh pl/scripts/validate.sh 2026-03-01
stdout '^valid: 3 tickets, 0 unsure'
exec sh -c 'jq -c "{id, label: \"spam\"}" pipe/stage/2026-03-01/records.jsonl > pipe/stage/2026-03-01/labels.jsonl'
! exec sh pl/scripts/validate.sh 2026-03-01
stdout 'labels that are not allowed: spam'
exec sh -c 'jq -c "{id, label: \"bug\"}" pipe/stage/2026-03-01/records.jsonl | head -2 > pipe/stage/2026-03-01/labels.jsonl'
! exec sh pl/scripts/validate.sh 2026-03-01
stdout '1 tickets have no label'

# The load refuses labels that do not match the extract, and the warehouse stays empty.
! exec sh pl/scripts/load.sh 2026-03-01
stderr 'do not match the extract'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^0$'

# Label drift: three days load with the label bug, then a day whose tickets are all billing is odd.
env PIPE_BUDGET_CENTS=100
exec sh -c 'for d in 2026-03-01 2026-03-05 2026-03-06 2026-03-07; do sh pl/scripts/extract.sh $d > /dev/null; done'
exec sh -c 'for d in 2026-03-01 2026-03-05 2026-03-06; do jq -c "{id, label: \"bug\"}" pipe/stage/$d/records.jsonl > pipe/stage/$d/labels.jsonl; sh pl/scripts/load.sh $d; done'
exec sh -c 'jq -c "{id, label: \"billing\"}" pipe/stage/2026-03-07/records.jsonl > pipe/stage/2026-03-07/labels.jsonl'
! exec sh pl/scripts/validate.sh 2026-03-07
stdout 'drifted'

# An empty day validates and loads with no rows.
exec sh pl/scripts/extract.sh 2026-03-08
exec sh pl/scripts/validate.sh 2026-03-08
exec sh pl/scripts/load.sh 2026-03-08
stdout 'loaded 0 rows for 2026-03-08 at version 2'

-- days.txt --
2026-03-01
2026-03-02
2026-03-03
-- src/open-2026-03-02 --
-- src/n-2026-03-03 --
5
-- src/n-2026-03-08 --
0
-- pipe/config --
SOURCE_API=http://source.test
-- pipe/credential.header --
X-Token: TESTONLY
